Every batch, in its block

Each strip is one block in ledger order: one tick per transaction, ours drawn wide. Inside each of our probes, the top number is its fee rank (1 is the highest fee of the batch) and the bottom number is its send order (1 was sent first). Read the top row left to right: 1, 2, 3 means the fee decided the order.
